WITH profile AS (
  SELECT 'dev_sean.threshold_yt_1k.new_channels' AS table_name,
         count(*) AS n_rows,
         approx_count_distinct(canonical_id) AS approx_distinct_channels,
         count_if(subscriber_count > 10000) AS rows_gt_10k,
         approx_count_distinct(CASE WHEN subscriber_count > 10000 THEN canonical_id END) AS approx_distinct_gt_10k,
         count_if(subscriber_count >= 10000) AS rows_ge_10k,
         approx_count_distinct(CASE WHEN subscriber_count >= 10000 THEN canonical_id END) AS approx_distinct_ge_10k,
         min(subscriber_count) AS min_subscriber_count,
         max(subscriber_count) AS max_subscriber_count,
         count_if(subscriber_count IS NULL) AS null_subscriber_count,
         count_if(country IS NOT NULL AND country <> '') AS rows_with_country,
         count_if(hidden_subscriber_count) AS hidden_subscriber_rows
  FROM dev_sean.threshold_yt_1k.new_channels
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dev_sean.threshold_yt_1k.new_threshold_channels', count(*), approx_count_distinct(canonical_id), count_if(subscriber_count > 10000), approx_count_distinct(CASE WHEN subscriber_count > 10000 THEN canonical_id END), count_if(subscriber_count >= 10000), approx_count_distinct(CASE WHEN subscriber_count >= 10000 THEN canonical_id END), min(subscriber_count), max(subscriber_count), count_if(subscriber_count IS NULL), count_if(country IS NOT NULL AND country <> ''), count_if(hidden_subscriber_count)
  FROM dev_sean.threshold_yt_1k.new_threshold_channels
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dev_sean.threshold_yt_5k.new_channels', count(*), approx_count_distinct(canonical_id), count_if(subscriber_count > 10000), approx_count_distinct(CASE WHEN subscriber_count > 10000 THEN canonical_id END), count_if(subscriber_count >= 10000), approx_count_distinct(CASE WHEN subscriber_count >= 10000 THEN canonical_id END), min(subscriber_count), max(subscriber_count), count_if(subscriber_count IS NULL), count_if(country IS NOT NULL AND country <> ''), count_if(hidden_subscriber_count)
  FROM dev_sean.threshold_yt_5k.new_channels
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dev_sean.threshold_yt_5k.new_threshold_channels', count(*), approx_count_distinct(canonical_id), count_if(subscriber_count > 10000), approx_count_distinct(CASE WHEN subscriber_count > 10000 THEN canonical_id END), count_if(subscriber_count >= 10000), approx_count_distinct(CASE WHEN subscriber_count >= 10000 THEN canonical_id END), min(subscriber_count), max(subscriber_count), count_if(subscriber_count IS NULL), count_if(country IS NOT NULL AND country <> ''), count_if(hidden_subscriber_count)
  FROM dev_sean.threshold_yt_5k.new_threshold_channels
)
SELECT * FROM profile ORDER BY table_name
